svg.title: Where the CPU goes in a Remotion render with footage
svg.desc: CPU seconds for 15 s of video R (450 frames). Full composition: 183.53 s, of which footage decode 99.3 s (54%), frame capture 76.25 s (42%), React and layout 7.98 s (4%). Graphics only, without footage: 27.74 s.
svg.text: Where the CPU goes in a Remotion render with footage
15 s of video R (450 frames), <OffthreadVideo>, CPU seconds per mode, parts found by subtraction

g.text: 27.7 s: capture 19.8 s, React + layout 8.0 s (4.4 s of it is start-up)
React and layout cost about 8 ms of CPU per frame. Decoding footage and taking screenshots cost the rest.

svg.text: data/experiments/cpu-breakdown.json. N=1 per mode, concurrency 4, 8 of 16 threads, shared server.
